item.question:
Simulate the mixing of two aqueous solutions in 1:1 proportions: the first containing 50 mmol/kg of dissolved inorganic carbon and the second containing 50 mmol/kg of calcium, as it is heated from 20°C to 200°C in 10 discrete steps, accounting for the precipitation and dissolution of calcite.

At 180°C, what is the pH of the mixture?

A. 7.405
B. 7.402
C. 7.401
D. 7.400
item.author: sc

{"path":"mix_heat_calcite.pqi","new_content":"TITLE Mix 50 mmol/kg DIC with 50 mmol/kg Ca (1:1), heat 20->200C, calcite equil
SOLUTION 1 DIC solution
    temp 20
    pH   7 charge
    units mmol/kgw
    C(4) 50
SOLUTION 2 Ca solution
    temp 20
    pH   7 charge
    units mmol/kgw
    Ca   50
MIX 1
    1 0.5
    2 0.5
EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Calcite 0 0
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
    -pH true
    -temperature true
USER_PUNCH
    -headings step
    10 PUNCH STEP_NO
END

REACTION_TEMPERATURE 1
    20 200 in 10 steps
END
"}
